rv.q: What makes “Antonio’s Song” truly sing is its bone-authentic journey from the worst to the best of human nature.
This is powerful storytelling at its absolute finest and a dynamic celebration of the importance of art in all our lives.
Striking and enveloping, “Antonio’s Song/I Was Dreaming of my Son” is the most honest and accurate portrayal of how men are formed emotionally that I have ever seen.
Antonio's Song is a brilliant, moving, and virtuosic performance that captures the essence of his journey.
"Antonio’s Song/ I Was Dreaming of a Son” is an incredibly powerful meditation on identity.

cn.t: Critics praise this honest, emotionally charged autobiographical solo show for its authentic portrayal of masculinity and fatherhood, with Antonio Edwards Suarez's skilled performance bringing universal resonance to his particular journey.
